name: Confectionery bar — brand and product name not in frame
note: One photo of the nutrition strip on a gold-foil 50 g bar. NO BRAND OR PRODUCT NAME IS IN FRAME — the id is a placeholder keyed to the burst. The right-hand block reads 'MADE IN AUST… / IMPORTED AN… / INGREDIENTS / PLEASE STORE I… / DRY CONDITIO… / THE COLOUR PU… / TRADE MARK US… / UNDER LICENCE', every line running past the frame edge. The purple-trade-mark wording is Cadbury's house statement, but no brand is printed in the frame, so brand is left unrecorded rather than inferred. Protein is printed as '<1.0 g' in both columns — not a number, so the protein key is omitted rather than guessed. Serving size '50g (1 bar)', 1 serving per package, so the bar is 50 g.
